processors.description: Drop OneAgent native GenAI spans that duplicate OpenTelemetry/OpenInference spans (e.g. ollama.chat)
OpenInference LLM spans: model, provider, token usage, request params, messages, finish reasons, legacy fields for bizevent metrics

dql.script:
parse metadata, "JSON:oi_metadata"
| parse output.value, "JSON:oi_output"
| parse llm.invocation_parameters, "LD 'guardrailIdentifier\": \"' ALNUM:gen_ai.guardrail.id"
| parse llm.invocation_parameters, "LD 'guardrailVersion\": \"' ALNUM:gen_ai.guardrail.version"
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.operation.name = "chat",
    gen_ai.request.model = coalesce(llm.model_name, gen_ai.request.model),
    gen_ai.provider.name = coalesce(llm.provider, gen_ai.provider.name, llm.system),
    gen_ai.usage.input_tokens = coalesce(llm.token_count.prompt, gen_ai.usage.input_tokens),
    gen_ai.usage.output_tokens = coalesce(llm.token_count.completion, gen_ai.usage.output_tokens),
    gen_ai.response.finish_reasons = coalesce(llm.finish_reason, gen_ai.response.finish_reasons),
    gen_ai.prompt_caching = if(toDouble(`llm.token_count.prompt_details.cache_read`) > 0, "read",
      else: if(toDouble(`llm.token_count.prompt_details.cache_write`) > 0, "write", else: gen_ai.prompt_caching)),
    gen_ai.request.temperature = coalesce(llm.temperature, gen_ai.request.temperature, toDouble(oi_metadata[ls_temperature])),
    gen_ai.request.max_tokens = coalesce(llm.max_tokens, gen_ai.request.max_tokens),
    gen_ai.request.top_p = coalesce(llm.top_p, gen_ai.request.top_p),
    gen_ai.system_instructions = if(`llm.input_messages.0.message.role` == "system", `llm.input_messages.0.message.content`),
    gen_ai.prompt.prompt_filter_results = toString(oi_output[prompt_filter_results]),
    gen_ai.input.messages = input.value,
    gen_ai.output.messages = output.value,
    llm.usage.total_tokens = toLong(llm.token_count.total),
    llm.request.type = "chat"
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.response.model = gen_ai.request.model,
    gen_ai.system = if(gen_ai.provider.name == "azure", "azure.ai.openai", else: gen_ai.provider.name),
    duration_seconds = if(isNotNull(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens) OR isNotNull(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens), toDouble(duration) / 1000000000.0)
| fieldsRemove oi_metadata, oi_output, input.value, output.value,
    llm.model_name, llm.provider, llm.system, llm.finish_reason, llm.temperature, llm.max_tokens, llm.top_p,
    llm.invocation_parameters, llm.token_count.prompt, llm.token_count.completion, llm.token_count.total,
    `llm.token_count.prompt_details.audio`, `llm.token_count.prompt_details.cache_read`,
    `llm.token_count.prompt_details.cache_write`, `llm.token_count.completion_details.audio`,
    `llm.token_count.completion_details.reasoning`,
    `llm.input_messages.0.message.role`, `llm.input_messages.0.message.content`,
    `llm.output_messages.0.message.role`, `llm.output_messages.0.message.content`

processors.description: OpenInference TOOL spans: gen_ai.tool.name/description, gen_ai.tool.call.arguments/result, gen_ai.tool.type

dql.script:
parse output.value, "JSON:oi_tool_output"
| fieldsAdd gen_ai.tool.name = coalesce(tool.name, gen_ai.tool.name),
    gen_ai.tool.description = coalesce(tool.description, gen_ai.tool.description),
    gen_ai.tool.call.arguments = input.value,
    gen_ai.tool.call.result = coalesce(toString(oi_tool_output[data][content]), output.value),
    gen_ai.tool.type = "function"
| fieldsRemove oi_tool_output, tool.name, tool.description, input.value, output.value

processors.description: OpenInference (all span kinds, after LLM/TOOL): gen_ai.operation.kind/name, gen_ai.agent.name, embedding/reranker/guardrail fields, source marker, cleanup of consumed llm.* fields
Traceloop/OpenLLMetry spans: map ls_temperature to gen_ai.request.temperature
ollama.client.request spans: convert Ollama timing fields to durations

dql.script:
fieldsAdd ollama.eval_duration = toDuration(ollama.eval_duration)
| fieldsAdd ollama.load_duration = toDuration(ollama.load_duration)
| fieldsAdd ollama.prompt_eval_duration = toDuration(ollama.prompt_eval_duration)
| fieldsAdd ollama.total_duration = toDuration(ollama.total_duration)
